ACT II OF 1990
ACT II OF 1990
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT AND RAIVANGI MAHSOOL VALIDATING) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979, and to validate the levy of Rawangi
Mahsool on certain commodities by the District Councils in the Province
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 16th January, 1990]
No.PAS/Legis-B-13/89, dated
16-1-1990.--The Sindh Local Government (Amendment and Rawangi Mahsool
Validating) Bill 1959 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on
29th November, 1989 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 4th January,
1990 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title.--This Act
may be called the Sindh Local Government (Amendment and Rawangi Mahsool
Validating) Act, 1989.

Amendment of Schedule V to Sindh Ordinance XII of 1979

ACT II OF 1990
ACT II OF 1990
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT AND RAIVANGI MAHSOOL VALIDATING) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979, and to validate the levy of Rawangi
Mahsool on certain commodities by the District Councils in the Province
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 16th January, 1990]
No.PAS/Legis-B-13/89, dated
16-1-1990.--The Sindh Local Government (Amendment and Rawangi Mahsool
Validating) Bill 1959 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on
29th November, 1989 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 4th January,
1990 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of Schedule V to
Sindh Ordinance XII of 1979. In the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979,
hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in Schedule V, in Part III, in
Entry 6, the full-stop at the end shall be replaced by semi-colon and
thereafter the following proviso shall be added and be deemed to have been so
added on and from the 1st day of September, 1983, and the 19th day of May,
1984, in the case of District Council Hyderabad and the District Council
Nawabshah respectively and from the 12th day of June 1986, in the case of other
District Councils:
"Provided that Rawangi
Mahsool shall be leviable on fire-wood, timber for use in construction of
buildings, wheat, jaw (barley), rice cotton (ginned, unpinned or waste),
rectified spirit, molasses, bagasse, sugar or sugar products such as missri,
rewri and sweetmeats, whether such thing or substance is exported from the
urban limits or rural limits of the revenue District."

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Local Government Amendment and Raivangi Mahsool Validating Act 1989
sections.description:
Validation of Rawangi Mahsool on certain commodities

ACT II OF 1990
ACT II OF 1990
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT AND RAIVANGI MAHSOOL VALIDATING) ACT, 1989
An Act to amend
the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979, and to validate the levy of Rawangi
Mahsool on certain commodities by the District Councils in the Province
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 16th January, 1990]
No.PAS/Legis-B-13/89, dated
16-1-1990.--The Sindh Local Government (Amendment and Rawangi Mahsool
Validating) Bill 1959 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on
29th November, 1989 and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 4th January,
1990 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
3. Validation of Rawangi
Mahsool on certain commodities.- Notwithstanding anything contained in the
said Ordinance, the rules thereunder or any judgment, order or decree of any
Court:--
(a) the
Government of Sindh, Housing, Town Planning, Local Government and Rural
Development Department Notification No. SOV/DC- V(7)/85, Part I, dated the 12th
June, 1980, authorising the levy of Rawangi Mahsool on certain commodities
shall always be deemed to have been validly issued and enforced and taken
effect accordingly but in the case of District Council Hyderabad and the
District Council Nawabshah it shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from
the 1st day of September, 1983 and. the 19th day of May, 1984, respectively;
(b) the Rawangi
Mahsool levied, assessed, charged, collected or realized by a District Council
in pursuance of the said notification shall always be deemed to have been
validly levied, assessed, charged, collected or realized.
